newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,493.6 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,493.6 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 350.9 million Swiss francs to 3,493.6 million in the reporting period ended January 31.
Statement of February 3 in millions of Swiss francs:

Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window fell by 4.5 million francs to nil in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates fell by 117.3 million francs to 282.6 million.
"Sight deposits are a little higher, but not for any special reason," SNB spokesman Werner Abegg said.
He added that technical factors had recently pushed sight deposits to the upper end of the range of normal levels.
